Subject: Re: DPA and subprocessors for NovaRetail pilot — subprocessors CSV + signing plan

Hi Elaine / Markus — thanks for the redlines. Quick update from our side and attachments included.

What we attached:
- subprocessors_export_2026-04-01.csv (CSV stub: vendor, service, region, role, last_updated)
- subprocessor_memo_2026-04-13.pdf (one-page descriptions)

Answers to your asks:
- Notification & objection: Redwood maintains a 30-day notice period for material changes to our subprocessor roster. For new high-risk vendors (as defined by our security team), we commit to additional outreach and will work with you on mitigation if an objection is raised. We can add the specific language from our SOP into the DPA redline.
- SCCs: We can incorporate the SCC Annex directly into the DPA as an addendum or reference the standalone SCCs; our legal team prefers the Annex as part of the executed DPA to keep everything in one place. We'll add proposed Annex language in a follow-up redline.
- Retention: We can add a retention table and make the default for non-PII logs 90 days; any exceptions (e.g., for debug traces requested during incident investigations) will be documented and timeboxed.
- Model tuning & prompt retention: Redwood does not use customer prompts to tune shared models by default. We have a configurable data usage setting; for this pilot we will set processing to "no training" and ensure no prompt retention beyond operational KV caching (ephemeral, <= 24 hours by default). We will call that out in the DPA.

Signing plan:
- If your redlines are final, we propose the following: Redwood legal will prepare a consolidated redline (incorporating the subprocessors notice language and SCC Annex), circulate for final sign-off, then produce a DocuSign envelope addressed to Avery Johnson (Head of Legal) at Redwood and to your authorized signatory.
- Expected timeline: consolidated redline within 24 business hours after we receive your final redline; DocuSign to be prepared same day and signature typically takes 1-2 business days.

Please confirm the authorized signer name/email for NovaRetail and if procurement needs to be added to the envelope.

Thanks — attaching the CSV and memo as stubs here.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
